top_stories.title: Announcing the OpenAI Safety Fellowship
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new Safety Fellowship program, signalling a renewed institutional commitment to AI safety research. The fellowship is designed to bring researchers into OpenAI's safety-focused work, expanding the pipeline of talent dedicated to understanding and mitigating risks from advanced AI systems.

top_stories.title: Gemini is making it faster for distressed users to reach mental health resources
top_stories.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant is rolling out an update that surfaces mental health resources more quickly when users appear to be in distress. The change reflects growing pressure on AI companies to address the welfare of vulnerable users interacting with conversational AI systems.

top_stories.title: Wikipedia's AI agent row likely just the beginning of the bot-ocalypse
top_stories.summary: A dispute over AI agents editing Wikipedia has highlighted broader tensions around automated bots and content integrity on open knowledge platforms. Malwarebytes argues the incident is an early indicator of far larger conflicts to come as AI agents become more capable of acting autonomously across the web.

top_stories.title: The one piece of data that could actually shed light on your job and AI
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review examines what kind of data would genuinely clarify how AI is affecting employment, arguing that most existing metrics are inadequate for understanding the real impact on workers. The piece highlights the challenge of measuring AI's labour market effects with precision.

top_stories.title: Iran threatens OpenAI's Stargate data center in Abu Dhabi
top_stories.summary: Iran has issued threats against OpenAI's planned Stargate data centre in Abu Dhabi, raising geopolitical security concerns around major AI infrastructure investments in the Middle East. The threat underscores the growing strategic importance — and vulnerability — of large-scale AI data centre projects.

further_links.title: Anthropic Study: How AI Is Impacting Tech Jobs and Workers
further_links.summary: A new Anthropic study examines the ways AI tools are reshaping roles and workflows for technology workers.

further_links.title: AI is changing how small online sellers decide what to make
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review reports on how Alibaba's AI tool Accio is helping small online sellers use AI-driven market research to guide product decisions.

further_links.title: How Meta Used AI to Map Tribal Knowledge in Large-Scale Data Pipelines
further_links.summary: Meta's engineering blog details how the company applied AI to capture and surface undocumented institutional knowledge embedded in its large-scale data infrastructure.

further_links.title: Import AI 452: Scaling laws for cyberwar; rising tides of AI automation; and a puzzle over GDP forecasting
further_links.summary: Jack Clark's Import AI newsletter covers new research on scaling laws applied to cyberwarfare, the accelerating pace of AI automation, and uncertainty in AI-driven economic forecasting.

further_links.title: When Virality Is the Message: The New Age of AI Propaganda
further_links.summary: Time examines how AI-generated content is being weaponised for propaganda, with virality itself becoming a tool of influence in the age of generative AI.

further_links.title: CMA Investigates Microsoft – Impact on AI, Business Software Market
further_links.summary: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority has launched an investigation into Microsoft's position in the AI and business software market.

further_links.title: AI singer now occupies eleven spots on iTunes singles chart
further_links.summary: A fake AI-generated artist named Eddie Dalton has taken eleven positions on the iTunes singles chart, raising questions about platform integrity and AI-generated content in the music industry.

further_links.title: The back story behind the first "$1.8B" dollar "AI Company"
further_links.summary: Gary Marcus investigates the origins and claims behind what was reported as the first $1.8 billion AI company, raising questions about AI valuation and hype.

further_links.title: Bernie Sanders: "AI Is a Threat to Everything the American People Hold Dear" [Paywalled]
further_links.summary: Senator Bernie Sanders writes in the Wall Street Journal that AI poses fundamental threats to jobs, democracy, and American society, calling for stronger government oversight.

further_links.title: How AI Helps Scale Qualitative Customer Research
further_links.summary: An industry piece examines how AI tools are being used to analyse and scale qualitative customer research, reducing time and cost for businesses.
